draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Hubli! Its railway station has platform number 1 at 1,507 metres, which made it the longest railway platform in the world as of March 2023.
draft.hungryLine: Go for North Karnataka staples like jowar rotti, badanikai palya and red chilli chutney, ideally at a local khanavali.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Rani Chennamma Circle is a 3 min walk, and the Indira Gandhi Glass House is within walking distance of it. Siddharodh Math is about 3 km out on Karwar Road.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Head to the Venkateshwara temple behind Nrupatunga Betta for some calm, or climb the hill for a panoramic view of the city.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Hubli houses the largest number of government offices anywhere in Karnataka outside the state capital.

tips.title: Eat at a khanavali.
tips.body: These local eateries serve authentic North Karnataka meals, and you'll find plenty of them.

tips.title: Grab a fresh juice.
tips.body: Sugarcane juice is around all season, and the juice shop opposite Janata Bazar is a local favourite.

story.title: Ranji cricket comes
story.body: Nehru Stadium hosted a Ranji Trophy match in 1972, with Mysore playing Kerala. More Ranji games followed in 1976 and 1992.

story.title: A big hospital grows
story.body: Karnataka Medical College became the autonomous KIMS in 1997. It's the largest multi-specialty hospital in North Karnataka.

story.title: A smart twin city
story.body: Hubli-Dharwad was picked for solar city and green city master plans in 2016. A year later it joined the national smart city project.

story.title: World's longest platform
story.body: Hubballi Junction's platform 1, at 1,507 metres, became the longest railway platform in the world. Platforms 1 and 8 actually share the same stretch.

story.title: North Karnataka's big city
story.body: Together with Dharwad, Hubli forms the largest city in North Karnataka. It's a bustling trading centre more than a scenic one.
